string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: Home: the top bar is only for the system (timer, alarm, no internet…); what is happening with the chosen item — On air, Recording, Playing, Stopped at, Connected, with % and time left — opens the details in the bottom right corner
Series, movies, podcasts and app videos stopped halfway show how far you got (e.g. “Stopped at T1 E1 · 35% · 43 min left”)
Home (Home Assistant) finds itself again on the network when the computer changes address: nothing to set up
Windows: the TV always shows under Network with its panel, and the TV drive has an “Open the TV panel” shortcut that follows the TV’s address

Alarm clock redesigned like the home screen: the time on big wheels with arrows, the options in a column with the value in orange, a sentence saying when it rings, days spelled out and the sound playing when you pick it; in the list, hold OK to turn an alarm on or off

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: With Series in focus, does the bottom right corner start with “Stopped at” with the episode, % and time left, and with TV “On air” with %? Does the top bar stay only with the clock?
Does the Home screen (lights) open normally?
On the computer, does the TV show under Network, and does the panel shortcut on the TV drive open the panel?
Open the alarm clock: can you change the time with ▲▼, go with ▶ to the options, pick a sound (it plays) and leave with BACK, with it saved?
